description: Milestones of a journey with dates and a time axis. Alternating vertical or horizontal, with optional media and actions. For events by people and systems, use ActivityTimeline.

howToUse: Use it for the milestones of a journey: an order from purchase to delivery, a project from kick-off to launch.
Pass the `items` in the order they happen, each with date and title; add media or an action when a milestone needs them.
Use `orientation="horizontal"` for few milestones in a wide area; vertical works on mobile.
alternatives: Many events by people and systems: ActivityTimeline.
Steps the person still has to do: WizardStepper.

keyboard.action: In horizontal, moves focus to the timeline.
In horizontal, scrolls to the previous or next milestones.
In horizontal, goes to the first or last milestone.

props.name: items
props.description: The order of milestones is set by the consumer, not by the visual state.
